{{Quote|The girl's fiancé said we could keep her.|[[Turk Falso/Legends|Turk Falso]]|<ref name="Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score">{{InsiderCite|144|Hondo Ohnaka's Not-So-Big Score}}</ref>}}
During the latter [[Standard year/Legends|years]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''male individual''' became engaged to the wealthy [[Wroonian/Legends|Wroonian]] [[Pelf Pachoola]]. However, after Pachoola was kidnapped and held hostage by the [[Weequay/Legends|Weequay]] [[Pirate/Legends|pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka/Legends|Hondo Ohnaka]], her fiancé refused to pay a ransom for her release.
